# Approved synthetic eight-format acceptance inputs

Eight exact files derive from the preserved offline Microsoft SAPI David Desktop/Zira Desktop synthesis of four fictional Alice/Bob test sentences. No microphone or private recording input was used. Original WAV SHA256: 3e6cf6e1fc99bb17e46734c50b5c7fcd3cbc78c9673c5473dafcb3395bad46d3, duration15.0099375s. Seven general-format derivatives use the first12seconds; the WAV retains the complete source. Bytes, media identities and request reservations are fixed in scripts/staging-remaining-eight-policy.mjs. The completed MP3 is excluded.

Owner explicitly approved public Git-history publication of these exact synthetic files on24October2026 (Sentinel_071f066042048191823edaf64745925a). They remain outside the root MIT grant. This publication supplies no Microsoft voice/engine assets and grants no additional third-party rights. Preserve provenance and existing rights; do not infer an additional media/voice licence from the code licence or owner publication approval.

The producer validates eight fixed hashes, codec/duration/layout and offline decode, then copies only the eight files into its flat artifact directory. This README and the producer receipt are not uploaded in that artifact. No private audio, additional synthesis, paid request or production deployment is part of fixture packaging.

The .mpeg and .mpga files intentionally carry identical MP3-encoded bytes for the two separately approved filename/MIME test cases. Specific approval Sentinel_d6b70f6ef1948191a7a70a4b65f5f477 covers these bytes as well; this adds no .mp3 filename or ninth request to the eight-file batch.
